summary: WISeKey International Holding filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a signed merger agreement to redomicile from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands. The transaction involves WISeKey merging into its wholly owned BVI subsidiary, with the BVI entity surviving and listing on Nasdaq and SIX. Each class of shares will be exchanged per ratios in the agreement; ADS program will terminate. Shareholder approval will be sought at an EGM expected in Q3 2026. No deal terms (price, premium) are stated. This is a jurisdictional reincorporation, not an acquisition or other special situation. Watch for EGM date, registration statement effectiveness, and regulatory approvals.
